tools.name: teams_auth_check
tools.description: Check whether the cached teams-cli session is still valid. Returns {status, hoursRemaining, account}.

tools.name: teams_auth_renew
tools.description: Silently renew the Teams Bearer using the persisted browser profile (headless).

tools.name: teams_health_check
tools.description: Probe Graph + chatsvc + chatsvcagg endpoints and report status for each.

tools.name: teams_login
tools.description: Capture a Teams web session by signing in via Playwright Chrome window. Interactive — opens a browser.

tools.name: teams_list_channels
tools.description: List channels in a team or across all my teams.

team_id.description: Team ID to list channels for. Omit for all teams.

tools.name: teams_list_chats
tools.description: List my chats (1:1, group, meeting). Returns recently-active chats with members and last message preview.

tools.name: teams_list_messages
tools.description: List messages in a chat OR channel. For chats, pass chat_id. For channels, pass team_id + channel_id.

team_id.description: Team ID (for channel messages, with channel_id).

tools.name: teams_send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a Teams chat via Graph. Channel sends are not supported (scope missing). The bridge prepends "[Claude]" to the body unless it already starts with it, so recipients always know the message came from an agent. Do not add a second prefix.

format.description: How to send the body. Omit and the bridge guesses from the markup, which it can only do approximately. Pass it whenever you know.

tools.name: teams_resolve_mri
tools.description: Resolve a Teams MRI (8:orgid:<aad-oid>) to {id, email, displayName} via Graph /users/{id}.

tools.name: teams_doctor
tools.description: Diagnose the teams-bridge MCP: node binary, CLI install mode, CLI version, MCP server version, auth status, last startup, and a single-line next-step suggestion. Call this first when something is broken.
